summary: Failed authored attempts expose safe timing through a fenced result; deterministic residual gates do not retry the whole deck.
invariants: Failed attempt timing contains no prompts, responses, credentials, filesystem paths, or raw provider payloads.
Completed slide checkpoints remain reusable and only failed slides enter bounded repair.
Font, QID, visible-text, and capacity preflight failures block provider repair before provider invocation.
forbidden: Whole-deck retry after deterministic residual capacity, composition, or sealed quality gate failure.
